subtitle: Eggs scrambled with tomato, onion and chile
verso: Green, white and red: the flag on your plate is spread.
story: Red tomato, white onion and green chile, the colors of the flag, scrambled with eggs. It's the breakfast every Mexican home makes without a recipe, and it's what goes into a taco on the way out the door.

ingredients.title: Eggs
items: 1–2 serranos, finely chopped (seeds in for more heat)

ingredients.title: To serve
items: Frijoles de la olla or refritos

steps: Heat the lard in a skillet over medium. Add the onion and serrano and cook 2 minutes, until soft but not browned.
Add the tomato and a pinch of salt. Cook 2–3 minutes, until it softens and most of its juice cooks off.
Beat the eggs lightly with a pinch of salt and pour them into the pan.
Stir gently with a spatula over medium-low until just set, still soft and moist.
Add the cilantro if using and serve right away with beans, tortillas and salsa.
pressureNote: No pressure-cooker version. It's a 10-minute skillet breakfast.
tips: Let the tomato cook down first, or the eggs turn watery.
Some grandmas don't beat the eggs first: they crack them right into the pan and stir, so you get streaks of white and yolk.
Leftovers make the best egg tacos for lunch.

variations.name: Huevos con Chorizo
variations.subtitle: Eggs scrambled with chorizo
variations.note: The other everyday breakfast taco. Some families add a diced potato fried with the chorizo.
steps: Fry the chorizo in a dry skillet, breaking it up, until it releases its red fat, about 4 minutes. Add the onion and potato and cook until the potato is tender, about 8 minutes.
Pour off extra fat if there's a lot. Add the eggs and stir until just set.
Taste before salting; chorizo is salty.

variations.name: Huevos con Nopales
variations.subtitle: Eggs with cactus paddles
variations.note: A Lent favorite, and a way to stretch the eggs.

items: 1 cup cooked nopales, in strips (from a jar, rinsed, or fresh and boiled)

steps: Make the base through step 2, adding the nopales with the tomato and cooking until any slime has cooked off.
Add the eggs and stir until just set.
